title: 超越静态几何的潜意识提示：因果深度与多Token混淆
summary: 本文研究语言模型通过看似无关的输出传递隐藏特质（潜意识学习）的机制。作者在动物-数字提示协议中分别测量固定输出向量相似度、隐藏状态可读性、因果控制及多Token测量，发现这些是冻结提示通道的不同属性，并揭示了长度混淆问题。
summary_en: This paper investigates subliminal learning, where language models transmit hidden traits through seemingly unrelated outputs. Using a fixed animal-number prompting protocol, the authors separately measure fixed output-vector similarity, hidden-state readability, causal control, and multi-token measurement, finding these are distinct properties of the frozen prompting channel and revealing a length confound.
